access_schedule.effect: Read native source pointer home, then exactly one unsigned WORD NUL guard at actual source. Source zero exits immediately: no control pointer-home/payload read or control cursor arithmetic.
Original saves EBX/ESI/EDI after first source guard and before testing its preserved flags; native frame aliases are excluded from ordinary Source domain.
Only for initially nonzero source: load control pointer home once, read its first unsigned WORD once and retain it in EDI for every outer iteration.

Test cached first control WORD and reset real control cursor to control base each source iteration. Cached zero skips all source-value rereads and control-tail reads; source still advances/scans through NUL.

For nonzero cached first control WORD, freshly reread current nonzero source WORD once, compare it with cached first control WORD. Match exits without advancing either cursor or rereading any payload.

On mismatch advance control cursor twice by one byte, read one unsigned WORD, test zero before equality. Zero completes this unsuccessful search. Nonzero tail WORD compares against saved source value; match exits, otherwise repeats. Tail positions are freshly read again for each next source iteration, not cached.

After complete nonmatching control scan, or cached empty control: advance source cursor twice by one byte, increment logical traversed-unit count once, then read exactly one next-source WORD guard. Zero exits; nonzero restarts cached-control test. NUL itself is never advanced or source-value-reread.

Always reread native original-source pointer home for SUB, restore registers, SAR EAX by one, RET without immediate argument cleanup. New ordinary local counter/unsigned encoding can avoid pointer subtraction; no mutable argument-home/block identity is asserted.

domain: Target Win32: 8-bit bytes, 32-bit pointers/unsigned int and little-endian unsigned 16-bit code-unit WORD loads. Arbitrary code units, including surrogates; equality/NUL only, no Unicode scalar/locale/case/normalization semantics.

Source must always supply a genuine stable live determinate readable first two-byte WORD. If that guard is zero, control may be any pointer/null and is never dereferenced. Otherwise every reached control WORD must be real stable readable storage.

All actually reached source guards/value rereads and control scans must remain in genuine live determinate readable storage with a finite reached stop. No full source terminator after an early match, no full control terminator beyond an earlier match, no padding or unvisited count extent required.

Every actual byte-cursor advance must be nonwrapping and stay within or one-past the same actual live allocation; every ensuing WORD read must have both bytes in-range and must never dereference one-past. No pointer before base, pointer subtraction, signed count/distance cap or fabricated uint16_t/wchar_t ownership/alignment.

Unaligned/interior/prefix raw byte regions, read-only storage, input/input overlap/identity and ordinary stable caller-stack allocation are allowed. Inputs and storage lifetime remain stable across all repeated reads; no MMIO, concurrent mutation, fault/recovery or lifetime-change protocol.

Exclude native callee-private saved-register/frame/return-address and argument-home/block self-alias protocols. Native original-source home is reloaded at return, and control home is read only after nonzero source; ordinary new by-value pointers/local state do not recreate physical home or stack/fault ordering.

Original_register_ABI.arguments: Native stack source home read at entry [S+4], control home [S+8] only after initial nonzero source; final source home [S+4] reread for subtraction. Two-pointer ordinary caller-cleanup interpretation is supported; saved wchar_t*/size_t metadata is not an authenticated source type/layout.
Original_register_ABI.preservation: EBX/ESI/EDI saved and restored; EBP untouched; ESP balanced, RET has no immediate cleanup. EAX becomes return bits; ECX/EDX scratch; no incoming hidden register value needed.
Original_register_ABI.flags: Initial CMP flags survive three PUSH instructions into JZ. Cached-control TEST flags survive MOV into JZ. Every condition derives from an explicit local comparison/test; no incoming flags or DF dependency.
Original_register_ABI.segments: No explicit segment override; normal DS pointer and SS stack defaults. Ordinary flat Win32/32-bit stack domain only; arbitrary descriptors, native fault and flag identity excluded.
Original_register_ABI.blockers: No calls/providers, global/TLS data accesses, helper, x87/SSE, string/REP, bitmap/table/buffer, exception dispatch, computed branch, hidden register input or listing repair identified in complete body.
